blocks.prompt:
1 Answer both parts on the early ideas about life: (i) Define evolution and state its earliest basic speculations. (ii) Compare creationism with the idea of spontaneous generation. (4 marks)
(Zindagi ke qadeem khayalaat par dono hisse: (i) Evolution ki tareef karein aur is ke ibtidai bunyadi qiyasaat likhein. (ii) Creationism aur spontaneous generation ke khayal ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Evolution population ki genetic banawat (allele frequencies) mein kai naslon tak batadreej tabdeeli hai jo nayi species bana sakti hai. Ibtidai qiyasaat:
1. Kainat aur jandar hamesha maujooda shakal mein nahi the.
2. Aaj ke jandar aik dam paida nahi kiye gaye.
3. Yeh adna se aala shakal tak be-shumar tabdeeliyon ka nateeja hain.

(ii) Creationism aur spontaneous generation:

book_ref.quote: Creationists claim that each type of organism was created individually

rows: 'Theory of intelligent design' bhi kehte hain.
Tamam jandar isi tarah banaye gaye jaise aaj hain.
Jandar be-jaan maadde se ban sakte hain.
Har qisam alag bani aur tareekh mein nahi badli.
Zindagi baghair walidain maadde se aati hai.
Tajrubaat ise radd nahi kar sake.
Science ki taraqqi ke saath tajrubaat ne ise ghalat sabit kiya.

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe Darwin's observations during the voyage of HMS Beagle and on the Galápagos Islands, and the conclusion he drew from them. (4 marks)
(HMS Beagle ke safar aur Galápagos par Darwin ke mushahidaat aur un se nikala gaya nateeja bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1831 mein Darwin HMS Beagle par naturalist ke taur par duniya ke gird 5 saal ke safar par gaye.

Safar ke dauran:
1. Tropical rainforests aur naye habitats mein paudon aur janwaron ka bara tanawwo dekha.
2. Fossils wali chattanon se pata chala ke bar-e-azam aur samandar waqt ke saath bohat badle aur badal rahe hain.
3. Bare naapaid mammals ke fossils se zahir hua ke maazi mein jandar mukhtalif the, yani jandar badalte hain.

Galápagos par:
1. Mukhtalif jazeeron ke paude aur janwar bohat mukhtalif the; aik jazeere ke kachhwon ke khol zeen jaise, doosre ke gumbad jaise.
2. Bohat se paude aur janwar doosre jazeeron se zyada South America walon se milte the.
3. Finches ki mukhtalif species ki chonchon ke size aur shakal mukhtalif khurak ki adaptations the.

Nateeja: nayi species aur adaptations qareebi amal hain. Asal habitat se alag naye mahol ki adaptations batadreej jama hone se aabai shakal se nayi species banti hai; kai naslon mein do populations alag species ban jati hain.

book_ref.quote: During the long voyage, Darwin visited tropical rainforests and other new habitats

blocks.prompt:
3 A female fish releases 200,000 eggs each season. Suppose every egg developed into a reproductive adult, half of them females, and each of these females also released 200,000 eggs the next season. How many eggs would be released in that next season? What does this show about Darwin's idea of overproduction? (4 marks)
(Aik maada machhli har mausam 200,000 ande deti hai. Farz karein har anda tolid ke qabil bara ban jaye, aadhe maada hon, aur har maada agle mausam 200,000 ande de. Agle mausam kitne ande honge? Yeh Darwin ke overproduction ke khayal ke bare mein kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab ki sea star misaal ki tarah: aadhe ande maada banate hain aur har maada utne hi ande deti hai.

book_ref.quote: a female sea star releases about 1 million eggs each season

steps: Chand naslon mein yeh tadaad mahol ki gunjaish se kahin aage nikal jayegi.
blocks.final_answer: 2 × 10¹⁰ (bees arab) ande. Jandaron ki tolidi salahiyat haqiqat se kahin zyada hai; wasail itne bachon ko sahara nahi de sakte, is liye bacha ki jang hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 State the Hardy-Weinberg theorem. Explain the conditions under which allele frequencies remain constant. (4 marks)
(Hardy-Weinberg theorem bayan karein. Woh sharaait wazeh karein jin mein allele frequencies yaksan rehti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1908 mein English mathematician Godfrey Hardy aur German physician Wilhelm Weinberg ne bataya ke bari, random mating wali population mein alleles aur genotypes ki frequencies nasl dar nasl yaksan rehti hain agar koi evolutionary quwwat amal na kare. Neo-Darwinism isi par mabni hai.

Sharaait (koi aik bhi toote to evolution hota hai):
1. Population ka size bara ho.
2. Mating random ho: har fard ko har doosre se mating ka barabar mauqa ho.
3. Population mein aamad ya rawangi (hijrat) na ho.
4. Mutations na hon; hon to wild type se mutant aur mutant se wild type mutations barabar hon.
5. Tamam genotypes ko bachne aur tolid ka barabar mauqa ho.

book_ref.quote: According to Hardy-Weinber theorem, any of the following conditions is not followed, evolution takes place

blocks.prompt:
5 A population of pea plants has a gene pool of 1,600 genes for flower colour. Of these, 1,040 genes are for purple colour and the rest for white colour. Find the allele frequency of purple and of white. (4 marks)
(Matar ke paudon ki population mein phool ke rang ke 1,600 genes ka gene pool hai. In mein se 1,040 genes jamni rang ke aur baqi safed ke hain. Jamni aur safed ki allele frequency maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Allele frequency = us allele ke genes ÷ khususiyat ke kul genes (gene pool).

book_ref.quote: If 600 out of 1000 genes are for red colour, the allele frequency of red is 0.6 (60%)

steps: Phool ke rang ka gene pool = 1,600 genes

blocks.prompt:
6 In a population of 250 plants, 90 are RR, 120 are Rr and 40 are rr. Find the genotype frequency of each genotype. If, after some generations, the population still has 250 plants but 100 are RR, has the genotype frequency of RR changed? (4 marks)
(250 paudon ki population mein 90 RR, 120 Rr aur 40 rr hain. Har genotype ki genotype frequency maloom karein. Agar kuch naslon baad bhi 250 paude hon magar 100 RR hon to kya RR ki genotype frequency badli?)
blocks.explanation: Genotype frequency = us genotype wale afraad ÷ kul afraad.

book_ref.quote: If 40 out of 100 plants are RR, the genotype frequency of RR is 0.4 (40%)

steps: Baad mein RR = 100 ÷ 250 = 0.40 (40%), jo 0.36 se mukhtalif hai
blocks.final_answer: RR 0.36, Rr 0.48, rr 0.16. RR 0.36 se 0.40 hua, yani genotype frequency badli; Hardy-Weinberg ke mutabiq koi evolutionary quwwat amal kar rahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain genetic drift and gene flow as factors that change allele frequencies. (4 marks)
(Genetic drift aur gene flow ko allele frequencies badalne wale factors ke taur par wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh woh factors hain jin se Hardy-Weinberg ke mafrooze poore nahi hote aur allele frequencies nasl dar nasl badalti hain.

(i) Genetic drift (neutral selection):
1. Jab ittefaqi waqiat genes ki frequencies par asar dalen to yeh genetic drift hai.
2. Natural selection ke bar-aks yeh tabdeeli ittefaq se hoti hai, fitness se nahi, aur chhoti populations mein sab se wazeh hai.
3. Misaal: aag khargosh population 100 se 10 kar deti hai; bache hue ittefaq se zyada tar bhoore hain, behtar mutabiq hone se nahi. Genetic tanawwo kam ho jata hai.

(ii) Gene flow:
1. Hardy-Weinberg farz karta hai ke koi fard population mein na aaye (immigrate) na jaye (emigrate).
2. Doosri population se afraad ki aamad naye mutations la kar foran gene frequencies badal sakti hai (evolution).
3. Afraad ki hijrat se gene frequency ki tabdeeli gene flow kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: Changes in gene frequency due to migration of individuals are called gene flow

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the role of mutation in changing allele frequencies. What are mutational equilibrium and mutation pressure? (4 marks)
(Allele frequencies badalne mein mutation ka kirdar wazeh karein. Mutational equilibrium aur mutation pressure kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hardy-Weinberg farz karta hai ke mutations na hon ya mutational equilibrium ho; magar mutations zindagi ki haqiqat hain.
2. Mutations tamam naye genes ka asal aur variations ka mamba hain jo adaptive ho sakti hain.
3. Yeh variations maujood rakhti hain taa ke group mahol ke jhatkon se behtar bach sake.
4. Asraat mukhtalif: zyada tar nuqsan deh; kuch aik mahol mein neutral ya nuqsan deh aur doosre mein bachne mein madadgar.
5. Mutational equilibrium: wild type se mutant aur mutant se wapas wild type mutation barabar hon; asar aisa jaise mutation hui hi nahi. Yeh kam hi hota hai.
6. Mutation pressure mutation se gene frequencies badalne ke rujhan ka paimana hai.

book_ref.quote: Some may be neutral or harmful in one environment and help an organism survive in another environment

blocks.prompt:
9 What are vestigial structures? Explain with examples from snakes and humans how they indicate evolution. (4 marks)
(Vestigial structures kya hain? Saanpon aur insanon ki misaalon se wazeh karein ke yeh evolution ki nishandahi kaise karti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Jandar aksar woh hisse rakhte hain jo apni ifadiyat kho chuke hon. Yeh aksar kamzor bane hote hain aur vestigial structures kehlate hain. Kabhi mufeed hisson ki yeh baqiyat tabdeeli yani evolution ka wazeh saboot hai.

Saanpon mein: boa constrictor aur python jaise kuch saanpon mein pichhli tangon (pelvic) ki haddiyon ki nanhi baqiyat hai jo un ke reptile aabao ke aazaa se bachi hai.

Insanon mein (taqreeban 90 vestigial structures):
1. Vermiform appendix: cecum ki baqiyat.
2. Coccyx (dum ki haddi): dum ki baqiyat.
3. Wisdom teeth: teesri daarhen jo aabao paudon ke tissue peesne mein istemal karte the.
4. Kaan ke muscles: kam bane aur bekaar, magar kuch log kaan hila lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Such remnants of once useful structures are clear indications of change i.e., evolution

blocks.prompt:
10 Answer both parts on molecular and microbial evidence: (i) How do scientists estimate the time since two organisms evolved from a common ancestral molecule? (ii) Explain how microorganisms have evolved resistance to antibiotics. (4 marks)
(Molecular aur microbial saboot par dono hisse: (i) Scientists kaise andaza lagate hain ke do jandar mushtarka aabai molecule se kab alag hue? (ii) Wazeh karein ke microorganisms mein antibiotics ke khilaf resistance kaise bani.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Guzra waqt maloom karna:
1. Qareebi janwaron ka DNA mushtarka jadd se aata hai; DNA proteins ke codes rakhta hai, is liye proteins bhi milte julte hain (homologous biochemicals).
2. Scientists mukhtalif jandaron ka DNA aur proteins nikal kar un ki banawat parhte hain.
3. Qareebi proteins aur DNA ke farq dekh kar aur mutation ki taqreeban yaksan raftaar farz kar ke mushtarka aabai molecule se guzra waqt andaza lagate hain.

(ii) Antibiotic resistance:
1. Bacteria antibiotic ke saamne zinda reh sakein, yeh antibiotic resistance hai.
2. Yeh bacterial genes ki mutations se ho sakti hai.
3. Natural selection se bana resistance ka gene bacteria ki agli naslon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Scientists can extract and analyse the structure of DNA and proteins of different organisms

blocks.prompt:
11 Give the evidence that supports the endosymbiotic theory. How does the Membrane Invagination Theory explain the origin of eukaryotes differently? (4 marks)
(Endosymbiotic theory ki taeed karne wale saboot dein. Membrane Invagination Theory eukaryotes ki paidaish ko kaise mukhtalif tareeqe se samjhati hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Endosymbiotic theory (Lynn Margulis) ke saboot:
1. Mitochondria (aur chloroplasts) ka size prokaryotic cells jitna hai.
2. In ka apna DNA hai jo prokaryotes ki tarah circular chromosome mein hai.
3. Yeh prokaryotes ki tarah binary fission se taqseem hote hain, jab ke eukaryotic cells mitosis se.
4. In ki membranes ki banawat eukaryotic se zyada prokaryotic membranes jaisi hai.

Membrane Invagination Theory:
1. Is mein chhote prokaryotes ko nigalna shamil nahi.
2. Balke prokaryotic cell ki membrane cytoplasm mein andar ko mur gayi.
3. Is se nucleus aur endoplasmic reticulum jaisi membrane wali structures banin.
4. Nateeja eukaryotic cell ka banna tha.

book_ref.quote: The membrane composition of mitochondria (and chloroplasts) is more similar to prokaryotic membranes

blocks.prompt:
12 Answer both parts on Lamarckism: (i) Explain Lamarck's idea of use and disuse of organs. (ii) On what bases was Lamarckism disproved after the discovery of inheritance mechanisms? (4 marks)
(Lamarckism par dono hisse: (i) Lamarck ka organs ke istemal aur adam istemal ka khayal wazeh karein. (ii) Wirasat ke mechanisms ki daryaft ke baad Lamarckism kin bunyadon par ghalat sabit hua?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Organs ka istemal aur adam istemal:
1. Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744-1829), French naturalist, ne 'Philosophie Zoologique' (1809) mein yeh khayal diya; un ke mutabiq jandar saada se pecheeda bane.
2. Mahol badalne par jandar kuch organs zyada aur kuch kam istemal karne lagta hai.
3. Zyada istemal wale organs mazboot aur kam istemal wale kamzor ho jate hain.
4. Lambe istemal ya adam istemal se in tabdeeliyon ko unhon ne 'acquired characters' kaha aur samjha ke yeh aulad mein jati hain.

(ii) Lamarckism ke radd ki bunyaden:
1. Acquired characters ki koi genetic bunyad nahi, is liye yeh agli naslon mein nahi ja sakte.
2. Organs jandar ki khwahish ya zaroorat se nahi badalte.

book_ref.quote: they disproved Lamarckism on the following bases
